description: This file implements functions for handling JSON Web Signature (JWS) processing, including parsing, encoding, decoding, signing, verification, and serialization in both compact and flattened JSON formats. It seems to be part of the JOSE (JavaScript Object Signing and Encryption) suite within a larger websockets library.
